en.t: Shapur I becomes co-emperor of the Sasanian Empire with his father Ardashir I
en.s: Shapur I (also spelled Shabuhr I; Middle Persian: 𐭱𐭧𐭯𐭥𐭧𐭥𐭩, romanized: Šābuhr) also known as Shapur I the Great was the second Sasanian King of Kings of Iran. The precise dating of his reign is disputed, but it is generally agreed that he ruled from 240 to 270, with his father Ardashir I as co-regent until the death of the latter in 242.

zh.t: 沙普尔一世与父亲共同统治萨珊帝国
zh.s: 240年4月12日，沙普尔一世加冕，与父亲阿尔达希尔一世共同统治萨珊帝国。沙普尔一世是伊朗萨珊王朝第二位“万王之王”，也被称为“伟大的沙普尔”；其确切在位年期仍有争议，通常认为他自240年统治至270年，父亲于242年去世前与他共治。

en.t: Anthemius is elevated to Emperor of the Western Roman Empire
en.s: The Roman emperor was the ruler of the Roman Empire, starting with the granting of the title augustus to Octavian in 27 BC. The title of imperator, originally a military honorific, was usually used alongside caesar, originally a cognomen. When a given Roman is described as becoming emperor in English, it generally reflects his accession as augustus, and later as basileus.

zh.t: 安特米乌斯被拥立为西罗马帝国皇帝
zh.s: 罗马皇帝是罗马帝国的统治者，这一称号始于公元前27年屋大维获授“奥古斯都”头衔。Imperator原本是军事荣誉称号，通常与原为姓氏的Caesar一同使用。英文资料称某位罗马人成为皇帝，通常指他即位为奥古斯都，后世则称巴西琉斯。

en.t: King Edwin of Northumbria is converted to Christianity by Paulinus, Bishop of York
en.s: Edwin (Old English: Ēadwine; c. 586 – 12 October 632/633), also known as Eadwine or Æduinus, was the King of Deira and Bernicia – which later became known as Northumbria – from around 616 until his death. He was the second monarch to rule both of these northern English kingdoms and the first to convert to Christianity. After he died in battle, he was venerated as a saint.

zh.t: 诺森布里亚国王埃德温由约克主教保利努斯改宗基督教
zh.s: 埃德温（古英语：Ēadwine；约586年—632／633年10月12日），又称Eadwine或Æduinus，约616年至去世前一直担任德伊勒和伯尼西亚国王，这两个王国后来合称诺森布里亚。他是首位统治这两个英格兰北部王国的君主，并率先改宗基督教。他在战斗中阵亡后被尊为圣人。

en.t: Having received the submission of the prince of Antioch, Raynald of Châtillon, Byzantine Emperor Manuel I Komnenos enters triumphantly the city of Antioch
en.s: Raynald of Châtillon (c. 1124 – 4 July 1187), also known as Reynald, Reginald, or Renaud, was Prince of Antioch—a crusader state in the Middle East—from 1153 to 1160 or 1161, and Lord of Transjordan—a large fiefdom in the crusader Kingdom of Jerusalem—from 1175 until his death, ruling both territories iure uxoris ('by right of wife').

zh.t: 安条克亲王雷纳德·德·沙蒂永臣服后，拜占庭皇帝曼努埃尔一世·科穆宁凯旋进入安条克城
zh.s: 雷纳德·德·沙蒂永（约1124年—1187年7月4日），也称雷纳尔德、雷金纳德或雷诺，是中东十字军国家安条克公国的亲王，1153年至1160年或1161年在位；1175年至去世期间还担任外约旦领主，该地是耶路撒冷十字军王国的一大片封地。他以“因妻权”（iure uxoris）统治这两个领地。

en.s: The sack of Constantinople occurred in April 1204 and marked the culmination of the Fourth Crusade. Crusaders sacked and destroyed most of Constantinople, the capital of the Byzantine Empire. After the capture of the city, the Latin Empire (known to the Byzantines as the Frankokratia, or the Latin occupation) was established and Baldwin IX of Flanders crowned emperor in Hagia Sophia.

zh.s: 君士坦丁堡之劫发生于1204年4月，是第四次十字军东征的高潮。十字军洗劫并摧毁了拜占庭帝国首都君士坦丁堡的大部分地区。攻占该城后，他们建立拉丁帝国，拜占庭人称之为法兰克统治或拉丁占领；随后，佛兰德伯爵博杜安九世在圣索菲亚大教堂加冕为皇帝。

en.t: Troops of the Fourth Crusade entered Constantinople and began a sack of the city, temporarily dissolving the Byzantine Empire
en.s: The Fourth Crusade (1202–1204) was a Latin Christian armed expedition called by Pope Innocent III. The stated intent of the expedition was to recapture the Muslim-controlled city of Jerusalem, by first defeating the powerful Egyptian Ayyubid Sultanate. However, a sequence of economic and political events culminated in the Crusader army's 1202 siege of Zara and the 1204 sack of Constantinople, rather than the conquest of Egypt as originally planned.

zh.t: 第四次十字军攻占并洗劫君士坦丁堡
zh.s: 第四次十字军东征是教宗英诺森三世号召的一场拉丁基督教远征，发生于1202年至1204年。远征名义上的目标是先击败强大的埃及阿尤布苏丹国，夺回由穆斯林控制的耶路撒冷。然而，一系列经济和政治事件使十字军先于1202年围攻扎拉，并于1204年洗劫君士坦丁堡，而没有按原计划征服埃及。

en.s: The struggle for Constantinople was a complex series of conflicts following the dissolution of the Byzantine Empire in the aftermath of the Fourth Crusade in 1204, fought between the Latin Empire established by the Crusaders, various Byzantine successor states, and foreign powers such as the Second Bulgarian Empire and Sultanate of Rum, for control of Constantinople and supremacy within the former imperial territories.

zh.s: 君士坦丁堡争夺战是拜占庭帝国在第四次十字军东征后于1204年解体所引发的一系列复杂冲突。交战方包括十字军建立的拉丁帝国、多个拜占庭继承国，以及第二保加利亚帝国和罗姆苏丹国等外国势力。各方争夺君士坦丁堡及原帝国领土的主导权。

en.s: The War of the Breton Succession or Breton Civil War was a conflict between the Counts of Blois and the Montforts of Brittany for control of the Duchy of Brittany. It was fought between 1341 and 12 April 1365. It is also known as the War of the Two Joans (French: guerre des deux Jeannes) due to the involvement of two rival duchesses of that name, Joan of Flanders and Joan of Penthièvre.

zh.t: 布列塔尼王位继承战争
zh.s: 布列塔尼王位继承战争又称布列塔尼内战，是布卢瓦伯爵家族和蒙福尔家族为争夺布列塔尼公国统治权而爆发的冲突，持续于1341年至1365年4月12日。由于两位同名的竞争公爵夫人佛兰德的让娜和潘蒂耶夫尔的让娜卷入战争，此战也称“两位让娜之战”（法语：guerre des deux Jeannes）。

en.s: The battle of Anfao was fought between the troops of rebel General Muhammad Askia and Sonni Baru, the legitimate ruler of the Songhai Empire on April 12, 1493, at Anfao, outside the capital of Gao, on the upper Niger. Despite being outnumbered, Askia's troops won the day. The victory of Muhammad Askia ended the Sonni dynasty.

zh.s: 1493年4月12日，叛军将领穆罕默德·阿斯基亚的部队与桑尼王朝正统统治者桑尼·巴鲁在安法奥交战。战场位于尼日尔河上游、帝国首都加奥城外。尽管兵力处于劣势，阿斯基亚的军队还是获胜。穆罕默德·阿斯基亚的胜利结束了桑尼王朝的统治。

en.s: The siege of Jeddah was a naval battle that took place in the harbor of Jeddah between a Portuguese expeditionary force under Lopo Soares de Albergaria and Ottoman elements under Selman Reis, and Egyptian Mamluks fleet. The Portuguese fleet arrived off the city’s coast on Easter day, 1517 (12 April), Hijri year 923, and moored in the channel.

zh.s: 吉达围城战是葡萄牙远征军与奥斯曼军队和埃及马穆鲁克舰队在吉达港发生的一场海战。葡萄牙舰队由洛波·苏亚雷斯·德·阿尔贝加里亚率领，奥斯曼军队由塞尔曼·雷斯指挥。1517年复活节当天（4月12日，伊斯兰历923年），葡萄牙舰队抵达城外海岸并停泊在水道中。

en.t: The Instruction of 12 April 1588 was enacted, which is widely regarded as the formal establishment of the Dutch Republic
en.s: In the history of the Netherlands, the instruction of 12 April 1588 (Dutch: instructie van 12 april 1588) is a decision of the States General of the Netherlands (also known as the "Generality") passed on 12 April 1588 during the Eighty Years' War. It transferred the duties of the executive branch of government from the landvoogd (from which Robert Dudley, 1st Earl of Leicester had recently resigned) to the Council of State.

zh.s: 在荷兰历史上，1588年4月12日训令（荷兰语：instructie van 12 april 1588）是荷兰三级会议于八十年战争期间通过的一项决议。该决议将政府行政权从总督手中转交给国务委员会；当时，莱斯特伯爵罗伯特·达德利刚辞去总督职务。此训令通常被视为荷兰共和国正式成立的标志。

en.s: The Sixth Austro-Turkish War, also known as the Austro-Turkish War of 1663–1664, was a short war between the Habsburg monarchy and the Ottoman Empire. The Ottoman aim was to resume the advance in central Europe, conquer Vienna and subdue Austria. The Ottomans managed to capture key strongholds, however, the Habsburg army under Raimondo Montecuccoli succeeded in halting the Ottoman army in the Battle of Saint Gotthard.

zh.s: 1663年4月12日，哈布斯堡君主国与奥斯曼帝国之间的第六次奥土战争开始，战事波及今天的匈牙利、斯洛伐克和克罗地亚。奥斯曼帝国意图重新向中欧推进，攻占维也纳并征服奥地利，且一度夺取数处重要据点；但蒙特库科利率领的哈布斯堡军队后来在圣哥达战役中阻止其前进。

en.s: The Battle of Amritsar was fought on 6 and 12 April 1709 between the Sikh forces led by Bhai Mani Singh and the Mughal forces sent by Aslam Khan, the Governor of Lahore. This battle was the first one fought after Guru Gobind Singh's death, even before Banda Singh Bahadur's skirmishes against the Mughals. This battle can also be referred to as The Unsung Battle of Amritsar.

zh.s: 1709年4月6日和12日，巴伊·马尼·辛格率领的锡克军队与拉合尔总督阿斯拉姆·汗派出的莫卧儿军队交战。这是古鲁·戈宾德·辛格去世后发生的第一场战役，早于班达·辛格·巴哈杜尔与莫卧儿军队的交锋。此战也称“无名的阿姆利则战役”。

en.s: The Provincial Congress of North Carolina was an extralegal representative assembly patterned after the colonial lower house that existed in North Carolina from 1774 to 1776. It led the transition from British provincial to U.S. state government in North Carolina. It established a revolutionary government, issued bills of credit to finance the provincial government, provided for the common defense, and adopted the state's first constitution.
en.n: American Revolution: With the Halifax Resolves, the North Carolina Provincial Congress authorizes its Congressional delegation to vote for independence from Britain.

zh.s: 北卡罗来纳省议会是一个不受殖民地法律承认的代表机构，仿照北卡罗来纳殖民地议会下院建立，于1774年至1776年间存在。它推动北卡罗来纳从英国殖民地向美国州政府过渡，建立革命政府、发行信用票据为省政府筹资、安排共同防务，并通过了该州第一部宪法。
zh.n: 美国独立战争期间，北卡罗来纳省议会通过《哈利法克斯决议》，授权其国会代表团投票支持脱离英国独立。

en.s: The 1781 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 12, 1781, in order to elect the Governor of Connecticut. Incumbent Nonpartisan Governor Jonathan Trumbull won a plurality of the vote in his re-election bid against other candidates. However, as no candidate received a majority of the total votes cast as was required by Connecticut law, the election was forwarded to the Connecticut legislature, who chose Trumbull as governor.

zh.s: 康涅狄格州于1781年4月12日举行州长选举。现任无党派州长乔纳森·特朗布尔在与其他候选人的竞争中得票最多，但无人达到州法律要求的过半票数，因此选举交由州议会决定。州议会选择特朗布尔继续担任州长。

en.s: The Battle of Providien was the second in a series of naval battles, fought between the British fleet under Vice-Admiral Sir Edward Hughes and the French fleet under the Bailli de Suffren, near India during the Anglo-French War. The battle was fought on 12 April 1782 off the east coast of Ceylon, near a rocky islet called Providien, south of Trincomalee.

zh.s: 普罗维迪恩海战是英法战争期间，在印度附近发生的一系列海战中的第二场，交战双方为爱德华·休斯爵士海军中将指挥的英国舰队与叙弗朗统领的法国舰队。战斗于1782年4月12日在锡兰东海岸外展开，地点靠近亭可马里以南一座名为普罗维迪恩的岩石小岛。

en.s: The Battle of the Saintes (known to the French as the Bataille de la Dominique), also known as the Battle of Dominica, was fought between the British and French navies on 9–12 April 1782 off Dominica during the American Revolutionary War. A British fleet under Admiral of the White Sir George Rodney defeated a French fleet under Lieutenant général des armées navales François Joseph Paul de Grasse, forcing France and Spain to abandon a planned invasion of Britain's colony of Jamaica.

zh.s: 圣徒群岛海战又称多米尼克海战，法国方面称“多米尼克之战”（Bataille de la Dominique），是美国独立战争期间英法海军于1782年4月9日至12日在多米尼克附近进行的一场海战。乔治·罗德尼爵士率领的英国白色中将舰队击败弗朗索瓦-约瑟夫·保罗·德·格拉斯中将指挥的法国舰队，迫使法国和西班牙放弃入侵英国殖民地牙买加的计划。

en.s: The Battle of Montenotte was fought on 12 April 1796, during the French Revolutionary Wars, between the French army under General Napoleon Bonaparte and an Austrian corps under Count Eugène-Guillaume Argenteau. The French won the battle, which was fought near the village of Cairo Montenotte in the Kingdom of Sardinia-Piedmont. The modern town is located in the northwestern part of Italy. On 11 April, Argenteau led 3,700 men in several assaults against a French mountaintop redoubt but failed to take it. By the morning of the 12th, Bonaparte concentrated large forces against Argenteau's now-outnumbered troops.

zh.s: 蒙特诺特之战于1796年4月12日在法国大革命战争期间发生，交战双方为拿破仑·波拿巴将军指挥的法军与欧仁-纪尧姆·阿让托伯爵指挥的奥军军团。战场在撒丁—皮埃蒙特王国的凯罗蒙特诺特村附近，法军获胜。该镇如今位于意大利西北部。4月11日，阿让托率3700人多次进攻法军一处山顶堡垒，均未能攻克。到12日早晨，波拿巴已集中大批兵力，阿让托部队反而处于人数劣势。

en.s: The Froberg mutiny was a mutiny within the British armed forces staged between 4 and 12 April 1807 at Fort Ricasoli on the island of Malta, then a British protectorate, by the Froberg Regiment. The regiment had been formed using dubious methods, with personnel recruited from various nationalities in Albania and the Ottoman Empire. The troops, who had arrived on Malta in 1806, were unhappy with their rank and pay.

zh.s: 弗罗贝格兵变是1807年4月4日至12日在马耳他里卡索利堡发生的一场英军兵变，参与者为弗罗贝格团。当时马耳他是英国保护国。该团通过可疑手段组建，从阿尔巴尼亚和奥斯曼帝国不同民族中招募士兵。部队于1806年抵达马耳他，士兵对自己的军阶和薪酬不满。

en.s: The Siege of Acapulco was a battle of the War of Mexican Independence that occurred on 12 April 1813 at Acapulco de Juárez. The battle was fought between the royalist forces loyal to the Spanish crown, commanded by Pedro Antonio Vélez, and the Mexican rebels fighting for independence from the Spanish Empire, commanded by José María Morelos. The battle resulted in a victory for the Mexican rebels.

zh.s: 阿卡普尔科围城战是墨西哥独立战争的一场战役，于1813年4月12日在阿卡普尔科-德华雷斯发生。佩德罗·安东尼奥·贝莱斯指挥忠于西班牙王室的保王派军队，与何塞·马里亚·莫雷洛斯率领、争取脱离西班牙帝国独立的墨西哥起义军交战。墨西哥起义军取得胜利。

en.s: The 1813 Connecticut gubernatorial election took place on April 12, 1813. Federalist Lieutenant Governor John Cotton Smith had become acting Governor on the death of Governor Roger Griswold on October 25, 1812. Smith was elected to a term in his own right, defeating Democratic-Republican nominee Elijah Boardman.

zh.s: 康涅狄格州于1813年4月12日举行州长选举。1812年10月25日，州长罗杰·格里斯沃尔德去世后，联邦党副州长约翰·科顿·史密斯开始代理州长。此次选举中，史密斯击败民主共和党提名人伊莱贾·博德曼，正式当选州长，获得自己的任期。

en.s: The Battle of Casaglia was a part of the Neapolitan War. An Austrian force under the command of Johann Friedrich von Mohr engaged a Neapolitan force under their commander, Joachim Murat. The battle took place around the village of Casaglia, seven miles northwest of Ferrara, and resulted in the Austrians recapturing the village from Murat.

zh.s: 卡萨利亚战役是那不勒斯战争的一部分。约翰·弗里德里希·冯·莫尔指挥的奥地利军队与若阿金·缪拉率领的那不勒斯军队交战。战斗发生在卡萨利亚村附近，距费拉拉西北约7英里。奥军最终从缪拉手中夺回了该村。

en.s: The 1827 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 12, 1827. Former congressman, speaker and Democratic-Republican candidate Gideon Tomlinson defeated incumbent governor and Toleration Party candidate Oliver Wolcott Jr., winning with 56.71% of the vote. The Democratic-Republicans in Connecticut had grown tired of governor Wolcott, and wished to replace him. They nominated Tomlinson instead, and Tomlinson fended off a challenge from Wolcott and his supporters.

en.s: The Motherwell by-election was held on 12 April 1945, following the death of Labour Party Member of Parliament (MP) for Motherwell James Walker. No general election had been held since 1935, at which James Walker narrowly gained the seat for Labour from the Unionist Party. There was a truce between the major parties: Labour, the Conservative Party, Liberal Party and the National Liberal Party. The Communist Party of Great Britain, which had held Motherwell in the past, also undertook to abide by the truce.

en.t: Yuri Gagarin becomes the first human in space
en.s: Soviet cosmonaut Yuri Gagarin launched aboard Vostok 1 and became the first person to travel into space and orbit Earth. The spacecraft lifted off from the Baikonur launch complex, in what is now Kazakhstan. Its flight lasted about 108 minutes and completed a single orbit before returning to Earth. Gagarin ejected from the descending capsule and landed by parachute, as planned for the Vostok system. The mission demonstrated that a human could survive launch, weightlessness, and reentry. It also gave the Soviet Union a major achievement in the space race and made Gagarin an internationally recognized figure.

en.s: The Space Race (Russian: космическая гонка, romanized: kosmicheskaya gonka, IPA: [kɐsˈmʲitɕɪskəjə ˈɡonkə]) was a 20th-century competition between the Cold War rivals, the United States and the Soviet Union, to achieve superior spaceflight capability. en.s: Operation Eagle Pull was the United States military evacuation by air of Phnom Penh, Cambodia, on 12 April 1975. At the beginning of April 1975, Phnom Penh, one of the last remaining strongholds of the Khmer Republic, was surrounded by the Khmer Rouge and totally dependent on aerial resupply through Pochentong Airport. With a Khmer Rouge victory imminent, the US government made contingency plans for the evacuation of US nationals and allied Cambodians by helicopter to ships in the Gulf of Thailand. Operation Eagle Pull took place on the morning of 12 April 1975 and was a tactical success carried out without any loss of life.

en.t: Jim Gary's "Twentieth Century Dinosaurs" exhibition opens at the Smithsonian Institution National Museum of Natural History in Washington, D.C. He is the only sculptor ever invited to present a solo exhibition there
en.s: Jim Gary (March 17, 1939 – January 14, 2006) was an American sculptor popularly known for his large, colorful creations of dinosaurs made from discarded automobile parts. en.s: Operation Deny Flight was a North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) operation that began on 12 April 1993 as the enforcement of a United Nations (UN) no-fly zone over Bosnia and Herzegovina. The United Nations and NATO later expanded the mission of the operation to include providing close air support for UN troops in Bosnia and carrying out coercive air strikes against targets in Bosnia. Twelve NATO members contributed forces to the operation and, by its end on 20 December 1995, NATO pilots had flown 100,420 sorties. The operation played an important role in shaping both the Bosnian War and NATO.

en.s: The Siege of Sloviansk was an operation by the Armed Forces of Ukraine to recapture the city of Sloviansk in Donetsk Oblast from pro-Russian insurgents who had captured it on 12 April 2014. The city was recaptured on 5 July 2014 after shelling from artillery and heavy fighting. On 12 April 2014, as unrest grew in eastern Ukraine following the 2014 Ukrainian revolution, masked men in fatigues, armed with Kalashnikov assault rifles, captured the city administration building. These men, who claimed to be pro-Russian fighters under the banner of the Donetsk People's Republic, subsequently gained control of the rest of Sloviansk and began to fortify it.

zh.s: 斯拉维扬斯克围城战是乌克兰武装部队从亲俄叛乱武装手中夺回顿涅茨克州斯拉维扬斯克市的一次行动。叛乱武装于2014年4月12日占领该市，乌军经过炮击和激烈战斗，于7月5日夺回。2014年乌克兰革命后，乌克兰东部局势日益动荡。4月12日，身穿军装、蒙面并携带卡拉什尼科夫突击步枪的武装人员占领市政府大楼。他们自称是“顿涅茨克人民共和国”旗下的亲俄战斗人员，随后控制了斯拉维扬斯克其余地区，并开始构筑防御工事。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Hungary on 12 April 2026 to elect all 199 members of the National Assembly. It was the 10th parliamentary election and the highest-turnout election since Hungary's transition to democracy in 1990. The incumbent Fidesz–KDNP government of Prime Minister Viktor Orbán was defeated in a landslide by the opposition Tisza Party, led by MEP and former Fidesz member Péter Magyar, ending the 16-year Orbán era.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Benin on 12 April 2026, following the 11 January parliamentary elections conducted in accordance with the national electoral code. President Patrice Talon, serving his second and final constitutional term, had maintained that he would not seek a constitutional amendment to pursue re-election. The contest, which international observers characterized as neither free nor fair, resulted in a landslide victory for Finance Minister Romuald Wadagni, who officially secured more than 94% of the vote.
